summary: Add a permanent regression check for pmcro-reflector's Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 QueueRoot derivation -- e.g. a small script or Pester test under plugins/pmcro-reflector/skills/reflect-and-seed/ that runs the two scenarios exercised ad hoc in trail fdd09c8b-6517-4858-a6d0-be15659aa649 (absolute -PmcroRoot lands under <root>/queue; default relative -PmcroRoot has no regression) against an isolated scratch trail, and fails loudly if a future edit reintroduces a QueueRoot path-derivation bug like the one just fixed.
